The decisive mistake was SpeciesSightingsData_Expert's claim at step 8 to have reviewed the USGS fact sheet. The USGS Nonindigenous Aquatic Species fact sheet (Search Result 1, `nas.er.usgs.gov/queries/FactSheet.aspx?speciesID=221`) was the most likely place to find the answer, 1954. No agent ever fetched that page. At step 5 AlligatorBiology_Expert only asked someone to review the link. At step 6 DataVerification_Expert said it would visit the URL but wrote no code to do so.

At step 8 SpeciesSightingsData_Expert said it had reviewed the page and found no year, though no page content had ever been retrieved. It then ran another generic web search instead of fetching the page, so the team never saw the answer.

AGENT: SpeciesSightingsData_Expert
STEP: 8
